statusLine.command:
input=$(cat)
cwd=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir')
model=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name')
rem=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.remaining_percentage // empty')
d=$cwd
case $d in "$HOME") d="~" ;; "$HOME"/*) d="~${d#"$HOME"}" ;; esac
line=$(printf '\033[38;5;31m%s\033[0m' "$d")
st=$(git -C "$cwd" --no-optional-locks status --porcelain=v2 --branch 2>/dev/null)
if [ -n "$st" ]; then
g=$(printf '%s\n' "$st" | awk '
BEGIN{c76="\033[38;5;76m";c178="\033[38;5;178m";c39="\033[38;5;39m";c196="\033[38;5;196m";c244="\033[38;5;244m";r="\033[0m"}
/^# branch\.head /{h=$3; if(h!="(detached)"){if(length(h)>32)h=substr(h,1,12)".."substr(h,length(h)-11); res=res c76 h r; bh=1}}
/^# branch\.oid /{oid=$3}
/^# branch\.ab /{split($3,x,"+"); ahead=0+x[2]; split($4,y,"-"); behind=0+y[2]}
/^\?/{u++} /^u /{cf++} /^[12] /{xy=substr($0,3,2); if(substr(xy,1,1)!=".")s++; if(substr(xy,2,1)!=".")m++}
END{
if(bh!=1 && oid!="") res=c244 "@" r c76 substr(oid,1,8) r
sfx=""
if(behind>0) sfx="<" behind
if(ahead>0) sfx=sfx ">" ahead
if(sfx!="") res=res " " c76 sfx r
if(s>0) res=res " " c178 "+" s r
if(m>0) res=res " " c178 "!" m r
if(cf>0) res=res " " c196 "~" cf r
if(u>0) res=res " " c39 "?" u r
print res
}')
ns=$(git -C "$cwd" stash list 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
[ "$ns" -gt 0 ] && g="$g $(printf '\033[38;5;76m*%s\033[0m' "$ns")"
line="$line $g"
fi
[ -n "$model" ] && line="$line $(printf '\033[38;5;101m%s\033[0m' "$model")"
[ -n "$rem" ] && line="$line $(printf '\033[38;5;66mctx %s%%\033[0m' "$(awk -v r="$rem" 'BEGIN{printf "%d",100-r}')")"
zc(){ case $1 in ''|*[!0-9]*) echo 244 ;; *) if [ "$1" -ge 85 ]; then echo 196; elif [ "$1" -ge 60 ]; then echo 178; else echo 76; fi ;; esac; }
tok=$(jq -r '.env.ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN // empty' "$HOME/.claude/settings.json")
[ -z "$tok" ] && tok=$("$HOME/.claude/api-key.sh" 2>/dev/null)
q=""
if [ -n "$tok" ]; then
cf="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/zai-quota-$(id -u).json"
now=$(date +%s)
mt=$(stat -c %Y "$cf" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
[ -f "$cf" ] && q=$(cat "$cf" 2>/dev/null)
cl="$cf.fetching"
lmt=$(stat -c %Y "$cl" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
if [ $((now - mt)) -ge 120 ] && { [ ! -f "$cl" ] || [ $((now - lmt)) -ge 30 ]; }; then
: > "$cl" 2>/dev/null
nohup sh -c 'r=$(curl -sf --max-time 10 -H "Authorization: $1" "https://api.z.ai/api/monitor/usage/quota/limit" 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$r" ]; then printf "%s" "$r" > "$2" && mv -f "$2" "$3"; fi; rm -f "$4"' sh "$tok" "$cf.$$" "$cf" "$cl" >/dev/null 2>&1 </dev/null &
fi
fi
if [ -n "$q" ]; then
vals=$(printf '%s' "$q" | jq -r '[[.data.limits[]? | select(.unit==3 and .number==5)][0].percentage // -1, [.data.limits[]? | select(.unit==6 and .number==1)][0].percentage // -1] | join(" ")')
p5=${vals%% *}
pw=${vals##* }
z=""
case $p5 in ''|*[!0-9]*) ;; *) z="$z$(printf '\033[38;5;%sm5h %s%%\033[0m ' "$(zc "$p5")" "$p5")" ;; esac
case $pw in ''|*[!0-9]*) ;; *) z="$z$(printf '\033[38;5;%smwk %s%%\033[0m' "$(zc "$pw")" "$pw")" ;; esac
z=${z% }
[ -n "$z" ] && line="$line $(printf '\033[38;5;101mglm\033[0m') $z"
fi
line="$line $(printf '\033[38;5;66m%s\033[0m' "$(date +%H:%M:%S)")"
printf '%s\n' "$line"
